scope: non-Mundarica source census and exact-locator conversion queue

canonical_work.author: Pallavi Raonka
canonical_work.title: Munda Politics and Land: Understanding Indigeneity in Jharkhand, India

scope_classification.method_signal_from_repository_abstract: fifteen-month ethnographic study, May 2017 to December 2018, using several forms of qualitative data
scope_classification.scope_warning: Do not generalize field-specific qualitative findings to all Munda communities, locations, or historical periods without proposition-level support.

canonicalization.repository_precheck: No exact Raonka match found in repository code search before insertion.
canonicalization.work_identity_rule: Handle, Virginia Tech landing page, dissertation PDF and supporting documents are manifestations/components of one dissertation record, not independent corroborating sources.
canonicalization.duplicate_policy: Canonicalize future citations by normalized title + author + year + persistent handle.

rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.redistribution_permission: not yet verified at file/license level
rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.participant_consent_ethics: requires full-text inspection before participant-derived evidence promotion
rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.cultural_sensitivity: land, identity, gender, political conflict and community self-representation require contextual and consent-aware treatment

required_before_promotion: obtain authoritative repository PDF through permitted access
record cryptographic hash and stable manifestation metadata
verify dissertation pagination and table/figure/appendix concordance
inspect methods, field sites, participant/sample description, ethics and consent
extract only proposition-level passages with exact page/section/table/figure locators
separate participant testimony/direct field evidence from author interpretation and cited secondary literature
tag temporal and geographic scope for every promoted proposition
review file-level reuse rights and cultural sensitivity before exposing quotations or derived media

promotion.reason: Repository metadata and abstract verify a high-value obtainable source, but exact page locators, ethics/consent, dependency provenance and file-level reuse have not yet been audited.
